## ValueTypeConstructors.page() method

One [Page](./contracts.page.md) of `item`<!-- -->s: the result of every list operation.

**Signature:**

```typescript
page<Sdk>(item: ValueType<Sdk>, options?: ValueTypeOptions): PageValueType<Sdk>;
```

**Returns:**

## Exceptions

`TypeError` when `item` is a `none` type.

## Remarks

A strict record: `items`<!-- -->, an array of `item`<!-- -->, and an optional `nextCursor` string, present exactly when more items remain. `nextCursor` is never `null`<!-- -->; absence means the listing is complete. The result also exposes `item`<!-- -->, so code that needs the items without the page (a collection reference resolves to an array of items) derives it from this same composition.
